item.chapter_label: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body
item.stem:
Meera rubs a small piece of buttered roti on a sheet of white paper in her school science lab. She holds the paper up to the light and sees a shiny, see-through patch where the roti was rubbed.

What can she correctly conclude from this test?

oily patch seen on paper / fat is present in the food
